text: 1. Age: FEDIAF Dog Late Growth puppies with an expected adult weight over 15 kg keep the calcium min of 2.5 g/Mcal and the Ca:P max of 1.6 after about 6 months of age, when FEDIAF allows 2.0 and 1.8 (AE52 and AF56 notes on the Healthy Dog Cat Reqt Data sheet).
source: DDS template Version 21OCT26b, Standards tab A140

text: 2. Breed: FEDIAF's preferred calcium max for Great Dane puppies (1.6% DM) is not applied (B63 note).
source: DDS template Version 21OCT26b, Standards tab A141

text: 3. Added nutrients: FEDIAF's EU legal maxs for copper, iodine, iron, manganese, selenium and zinc apply only to amounts added as additives, but are applied here to every diet (J3 note on the Healthy Dog Cat Reqt Data sheet).
source: DDS template Version 21OCT26b, Standards tab A142

text: 4. Sources: iron added as oxide or carbonate and copper added as oxide should not be counted toward the mins (B78 and B80 notes); limits on added selenium and on phosphorus from soluble sources (cats) are not checked (B89 and B67 notes).
source: DDS template Version 21OCT26b, Standards tab A143

text: 5. Conditional mins: the cat vitamin K and biotin mins apply to every diet, although the standards make them conditional (B102 and B116 notes).
source: DDS template Version 21OCT26b, Standards tab A144

text: 6. Reference animals: NRC's per kg body weight^0.67 values for kittens and lactating queens apply to one reference animal; this sheet uses them for every kitten or queen (AG3 and AQ3 notes on the Healthy Dog Cat Reqt Data sheet).
source: DDS template Version 21OCT26b, Standards tab A145

text: 7. Moisture: foods with more than 12% moisture count as wet, a lower cut than FEDIAF's 14% (B40 note); FEDIAF's wet-diet selenium values per kg BW^0.75 (dogs) or BW^0.67 (cats) are not used (B91 note).
source: DDS template Version 21OCT26b, Standards tab A146

text: 8. Energy density: under an AAFCO requirement, the mins of a food below 4 kcal/g DM are raised to AAFCO's dry matter basis but its maxs stay per Mcal, so it can read above a max it meets on a dry matter basis (C130 note).
source: DDS template Version 21OCT26b, Standards tab A147

text: 9. Not calculated, only stated in notes: FEDIAF's increase of essential amino acids below 80% protein digestibility and the protein needs of bitches fed little carbohydrate (B12), vitamin E for high PUFA or fish oil diets (B100), vitamin B6 with protein in cats (B112), trace minerals at high calcium (B85), magnesium and urine pH in cats (B76), and processing and storage losses (G1 and B104).
source: DDS template Version 21OCT26b, Standards tab A148

text: 10. This sheet's own choices where the standards give no value: range highs derived from the min (K1 and K72 notes; Exceptions to Range High sheet), the carbohydrate default min (C124), the energy density range (C130), the energy estimates for the AAFCO requirements (G4 note on the Healthy Dog Cat Reqt Data sheet) and the folate DFE conversion (B114).
source: DDS template Version 21OCT26b, Standards tab A149
